symbols.name: IPipelineBehavior
symbols.summary: Defines a pipeline behavior for processing requests or notifications.
symbols.remarks: This interface is implemented by behavior classes to provide cross-cutting concerns (e.g., validation, retry, timeout) in the request or notification processing pipeline. Behaviors can access options (BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.SendOptions for requests, BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.PublishOptions for notifications) and call the next behavior or handler in the pipeline.

syntax.content: public interface IPipelineBehavior where TRequest : class where TResponse : IResult

symbols.name: HandleAsync(TRequest, object, Type, Func>, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Processes a request or notification, calling the next behavior or handler in the pipeline.

syntax.content: Task HandleAsync(TRequest request, object options, Type handlerType, Func> next, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

parameters.description: The request or notification to process.

The cancellation token to cancel the operation.

returns.description: A task representing the result of the operation, returning a TResponse.
